Name: Jude, Brother of James
Role: Servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James
Summary: Jude describes himself as the servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, and wrote his short letter urging believers to contend earnestly for the faith once delivered to the saints.
KeyStory: Jude describes himself as the servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, and wrote his short letter urging believers to contend earnestly for the faith once delivered to the saints.
LifeLesson: Contending for the faith is done as a servant, not as a master of it.
